label: W: the fewest registers between two nodes
section: W: the fewest registers between two nodes
subgoals: List the paths from u to v
Count the registers on each path
Take the minimum as W(u, v)

label: D: the critical delay at that register count
section: D: the critical delay at that register count
subgoals: Restrict to the paths from u to v that carry W(u, v) registers
Sum the node delays along each, endpoints included
Take the maximum as D(u, v)

label: Period constraints
subgoals: Write r(u) - r(v) at most w(e) for each edge
Write r(u) - r(v) at most W(u, v) - 1 for each pair with D(u, v) above c
Solve the difference constraints with Bellman-Ford
